description: Bit depth and colour encoding of the export (recording plan R4, R-090 P1, P2, P7, P10, decision 100) on the 4x2 plane grid: one channel per format (User0 sRGB8, User1 RGB8, User2 L8, User3 RGB16, User4 L16, User5 RGB16F, User6 L16F, User7 RGB32F, Opacity L32F) and the sRGB8 material channels Specular and Emissive, with BaseColor, SpecularRoughness and Height; mesh maps normal-b (Normal), grey A (AO), grey B (Curvature), field A (Position). Per set (L channels take the grey fixture): s0 field A, Normal normal-a; s1 the half-step codes; s2 uniform (0.8, 0.3, 0.1) and 0.37, Height 0.1 + 2^-13; s3 Height field A at 0.5; s4 the height ramps twice in LinearDodge (up to 2); s5 grey A in SignedAddition onto the empty stack (down to -0.5); s6 uniform 0.1 + 2^-13, Normal normal-a-8bit; s7 BaseColor and SpecularRoughness grey A (the rest empty). Every channel at PNG 8, PNG 16, OpenEXR 16f and 32f; Normal_OpenGL and Normal_DirectX at PNG 8, 16 and OpenEXR 16f; the four mesh maps at all four, and with passthrough at PNG 16 and OpenEXR 32f. Infinite padding, no dithering, every export step done twice in the session.
